unit_title: Origin and Founding of the Roman Empire

questions.stem: Which mythological figures are believed to have founded Rome?
questions.explanation_correct: According to mythology, Romulus and Remus founded Rome.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. According to mythology, Romulus and Remus founded Rome.

questions.stem: The Roman Empire was founded in the 5th century BC.
questions.explanation_correct: Correct, it's believed Rome was founded in the 8th century BC.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect, it's believed that Rome was founded in the 8th century BC, not the 5th.

questions.stem: The two twins who founded Rome according to the myth are ______ and ______.
questions.explanation_correct: Correct, the twins are Romulus and Remus.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect, the twins who founded Rome according to the myth are Romulus and Remus.

questions.stem: The Roman Empire was founded after the end of which kingdom?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct, the Roman Empire was established after the end of the Roman Kingdom.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect, the Roman Empire was established after the end of the Roman Kingdom.
